title: Measurement of labile and protein-bound heme in fixed prostate cancer cells and in cellular fractions
protocol: Treat cells with exogenous heme for a duration ranging from 30 min to 24 hours, depending on the specific cell line and desired concentration ranging from 1 to 50 μM.
Thaw an aliquot of heme in the dark.
Prepare complete medium and add heme at the desired concentration.
Aspirate the cell culture medium from the plate.
Add fresh complete medium with heme (1–50 μM) to the cells.
Place the cell plate back into the humidified incubator at 37°C.
Incubate for appropriate time.
Take out the cell plate from the incubator and aspirate cell culture medium.
Wash cells with 1× PBS.
Add 2–3 mL of 0.05% Trypsin containing EDTA to detach cells.
Incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
Collect each sample in a 15 mL conical tube upon blocking the trypsin with 8 mL of complete cell culture medium containing 10% FBS.
Centrifuge at 700 × g for 5 min and discard the supernatant.
Add 5 mL of ice-cold PBS to the pellet, pipette several times to mix well.
Centrifuge at 700 × g for 5 min and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL of ice-cold PBS.
Transfer each sample to a clean microcentrifuge tube.
Spin at 700 × g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 400 μL of Cytosol Extraction Buffer.
Pipette several times to mix well on ice.
Incubate samples on ice for 20 min.
Vortex every 5 min.
Centrifuge the samples at 700 × g for 10 min.
Collect the supernatant as the Cytosolic Fraction.
Place in a new Eppendorf tube and keep on ice.
Precool the centrifuge if necessary.
Place Membrane Extraction Buffer A and Eppendorf tubes on ice.
Resuspend the pellet in 400 μL of ice-cold Membrane Extraction Buffer A.
Pipette up and down several times to mix well.
Vortex for 15 sec.
Add 22 μL of Membrane Extraction Buffer B.
Vortex for 5 sec.
Incubate on ice for 1 min.
Vortex for 5 sec.
Centrifuge at 1,000 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant (Membrane Protein fraction).
Resuspend the pellet in 200 μL of ice-cold Nuclear Extraction Buffer A and vortex for 15 sec to mix well.
Incubate samples on ice for 40 min.
Vortex every 10 min for 15 sec.
Sonicate samples.
Centrifuge samples at maximum speed for 10 min at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant as the Nuclear Fraction and place in a new Eppendorf tube.
Keep the collected fractions on ice.
Determine protein concentration in Cytosolic and Nuclear fractions using the standard BCA Protein Assay kit.
Measure labile heme in cells and/or cellular fractions using the Hemin Colorimetric Assay Kit.
Prepare the Hemin Standard Curve by diluting 10 μM Hemin Standard to 100 nM with Hemin Assay Buffer.
Dilute Heme Standard further to 10 nM by adding 100 μl to 900 μl Hemin Assay buffer.
Add 0, 4, 8, 12, 16, and 20 μl of Hemin Standard into a series of wells in a 96 well plate.
Adjust the volume of each well containing Hemin Standard to 50 μl by adding Hemin Assay Buffer.
Dilute samples 100-fold for prostate cancer cell lines or adjust dilution according to the specific cell type.
Add 10 μl of diluted sample per well in duplicates in the 96 well plate.
Adjust the volume of each well containing diluted sample to 50 μl by adding Hemin Assay Buffer.
Determine the dilution factor for samples based on heme content before starting the experiment.
Prepare the Reaction Mix according to kit instructions.
Add 50 μl of the Reaction Mix to each well containing Hemin Standard or sample.
Incubate the wells for 10–30 min at room temperature (15°C–25°C), while protecting from light.
Read absorbance of the plate at 570 nm using a spectrophotometer.
Load each well of a 96 well plate with 10 μL of protein lysate at a concentration of 5 μg/μL.
Keep the plate on ice until Benzidine Staining Solution is added.
Prepare Benzidine Staining Working Solution by adding 500 μL of Benzidine Stock Solution to 50 μL of 30% H2O2 Solution in an Eppendorf tube.
Dilute the mixture 1:50 in PBS to obtain the final Benzidine Staining Working Solution.
Add 100 μL of Benzidine Staining Working Solution to each well containing the protein lysate.
Incubate the plate at room temperature (15°C–25°C) for 5 minutes, protected from light.
Read absorbance of the plate at 570 nm using a spectrophotometer for both protocols.
Stain cells grown on glass coverslips that have been treated with heme using Benzidine solution.
Incubate the stained cells in a humidified chamber for 20 minutes at room temperature (15°C–25°C), protected from light.
Wash each glass coverslip at least three times with 1× PBS.
Fix the cells by adding 2% PFA to each glass coverslip.
Incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Wash each glass coverslip at least three times with 1× PBS.
Wash each glass coverslip once in distilled water.
Proceed to hematoxylin staining for 15–30 seconds.
Proceed to de-hydration of the samples by incubating in ethanol 50% (3 minutes).
Incubate in ethanol 70% (3 minutes).
Incubate in ethanol 80% (3 minutes).
Incubate in ethanol 95% (3 minutes).
Incubate in ethanol 100% (5 minutes).
Incubate in xylol (5 minutes).
Mount each coverslip on a glass slide.
Let the slides dry while protecting from light.
